engineeringTrust.trustSafeguardLink: Ukwethenjwa okunezendlalelo: Ukuphepha kwe-Google Vertex kanye nezindlela zokuvikela ze-SceneFlow, ukuqinisekisa, kanye nomthombo — bheka isigaba esithi Ukwethenjwa Nokuphepha ngezansi.

audienceResonance.title: Audience Resonance: yakhela isiko, hhayi ikhodi yolimi
audienceResonance.description: Imibhalo engezansi yandisa ukufinyelela kwevidiyo eyodwa. I-SceneFlow ikuvumela ukuthi uchaze isiko, isifunda, kanye nohlobo lwezethameli ozenzela umsebenzi, uhlole indaba ngokuhambisana nalezo zethameli ngaphambi kokukhiqiza umkhiqizo wokugcina, bese ukhipha kungaba yinguqulo enamazwi abizwe kabusha (dubbed master) noma inguqulo ehlukile ehambisana kakhulu nezethameli ezithile.
bullets: Chaza izethameli: izifunda eziyisishiyagalombili okuhloswe ngazo, kanye nobudala, ubulili, imfundo kanye nomphakathi.
Chaza isiko, ukholo, kanye nezindinganiso ngamazwi akho — i-SceneFlow ifunda izimpawu.
Thola amaphuzu okusebenza kahle kanye neziphakamiso zokulungisa izingxenye ezithile ngaphambi kokuba uchithe imali ekwenzeni izithombe zokugcina (ama-render).
Yenza inguqulo eyinhloko (master), noma ukhiqize inguqulo ehlukile ehambisana nezethameli ngazinye.

howWeScore.title: Indlela i-Audience Resonance esebenza ngayo
howWeScore.description: I-Audience Resonance ihlanganisa ukuhlaziywa kwesakhiwo sendaba (ukucaca, isivinini sokuhamba kwendaba, kanye nokushintsha kwemizwa) nokuhambisana nohlobo lwezithameli ozichaze ku-Blueprint — hhayi izibalo ezingabalulekile noma imininingwane yokuthi abantu baqhubeka kanjani nokubuka ngemuva kokushicilelwa. Uma incazelo yezithameli zakho iqukethe izici zamasiko, ukuhlaziya kuqinisekisa ukuthi amagama, izindlela zokukhuluma, amasiko, izinkolelo, kanye nezindaba ezibucayi kuvezwa ngendlela eyiyo neyiqiniso. Izincomo zihlotshaniswa nezingxenye ezithile zombhalo ukuze ukwazi ukulungisa izinkinga ngaphambi kokuba ama-ejenti aqale ukukhiqiza ividiyo.
bullets: Ihlola i-Blueprint kanye nombhalo ngokuhambisana nezithameli oziqondisile.
Ukuhlolwa kokuba yiqiniso ngokwesiko maqondana namagama, izinhlobo zolimi, amasiko, inkolo, kanye nezindaba ezithinta imizwa yabantu
Izincomo ezisezingeni lesigaba — hhayi inombolo engacacile edinga ukuthi "usithembe" nje
Yenza lokhu ngaphambi kokusebenzisa imali eningi ekwenzeni i-render, hhayi ngemuva kokushicilela.

express.title: SceneFlow Agents
express.description: I-Audio Agent, i-Stills Agent, kanye ne-Video Agent zakha imiyalelo yochwepheshe ngokusekelwe ekuqondisweni kwesigqi, zinamathisele izinkomba ezifanele, bese zikhiqiza ngesikhathi esisodwa. Isigcawu singathatha imizuzu embalwa ngoba i-ejenti yenza umsebenzi okhethekile — bese uvumela i-Shot Frames ngaphambi kokuba uchithe imali kuvidiyo enyakazayo.

items.title: Pre-vis Agent
items.desc: Kufakwe amazwi nomculo ngokugcwele kuzo zonke izigaba (beat frames) zesigcawu ngasinye, kulandelwa iziqondiso eziqinisekisiwe, futhi sekulungele ukwabiwa ku-Screening Room.

items.title: Imigomo ye-ejenti ye-SFAIVIDEO
items.desc: Ividiyo enyakazayo yakhiwa ngokwesigcawu ngasinye ngemuva kokugunyazwa kwesibonelo sokuqala (Pre-Vis), kungaba ngezilimi zomdabu noma ngokufakwa kwamazwi okungabizi kakhulu, kuhlanganise nokulungiswa okwenziwa ezingeni lesigcawu.

items.title: Imigomo ye-ejenti yokulethwa kwe-SFAI
items.desc: Hlanganisa ifayela eliyinhloko le-ProRes 4K bese ulishicilela ngokuzenzakalelayo ku-YouTube noma ulande iphakethe.

preVisEngine.title: I-Pre-Visualization Engine
preVisEngine.subtitle: Ukukhiqiza i-Pre-Vis (noma i-animatic, njengoba ibizwa kanjalo embonini) ethatha imizuzu engu-40, enamazwi aphelele nomculo, ngemizuzu engu-15 akuyona nje isinyathelo sokusebenza — kodwa kuwumkhiqizo uqobo. E-Hollywood, i-pre-vis ithatha amasonto amaningi futhi ibiza izinkulungwane eziningi zamadola; kanti ngale ndlela entsha, kuthatha imizuzu embalwa kuphela futhi kubiza imali encane kakhulu.
preVisEngine.narrative: Embonini yamafilimu, i-storyboard yinto oyinikeza ithimba lokusebenza. I-Pre-vis yinto oyikhombisa abaphathi besitudiyo, abatshali-zimali, kanye nabakhiqizi ukuze uthole imvume yokuqala iphrojekthi. I-SceneFlow iphakamisa izinga lokukhiqiza lisuka ekubeni ithuluzi nje labadali abazimele liye ekubeni yingxenye ebalulekile yohlelo lokusebenza lwezinga lebhizinisi.

pillars.title: Isethulo Sebhizinisi Esiphelele
pillars.description: Layisha umbhalo bese ungena emhlanganweni wokwethula iphrojekthi uphethe uhlaka olubonakalayo lwangaphambi kokukhiqiza (pre-vis) oluhlanganisa amazwi, umculo, nezilimi eziningi, kanye nedatha eqinile evela ku-Audience Resonance. Nikeza abadali indlela esheshayo nephumelelayo — esekelwe kudatha kanye nezinto ezibonakalayo nezizwakalayo — yokwenza amafilimu abo.

pillars.title: Isigaba Sangaphambi Kokukhiqiza Esivumela Ukuthola Amaphutha Ngokushesha
pillars.description: Indlela evamile yokwenza uhlaka lokuqala lwevidiyo (pre-visualization) idinga ochwepheshe bokugqwayiza nge-3D, abadwebi bezithombe ezichaza ukulandelana kwezigcawu, kanye nabalingisi bamazwi isikhathi esingamasonto amaningi. Uma isigcawu singaphumeleli, kuchithwa izinkulungwane eziningi zamadola. Ungenza izinguquko nokulungisa uhlaka kungakapheli imizuzu engu-15, ngaphambi kokuba kuqashwe ngisho nelungu elilodwa lethimba lekhamera.

pillars.title: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezindaba Zezezimali
pillars.description: Lokhu kuheha ingxenye yomkhakha eqaphe kakhulu mayelana nobungozi: abaxhasi bezimali. Khombisa ukuthi isivinini sokuhamba kwendaba, isimo sayo, kanye nezingxoxo kuhambisana kanjani nezethameli ezihlosiwe ngaphambi kokuba kuchithwe ngisho idola elilodwa ekukhiqizeni.

workflow.title: Reference Library → Ukubuka kuqala (Pre-Vis) → Ividiyo enyakazayo → Ifayela eliyinhloko le-ProRes 4K
steps: Yakha umtapo wolwazi lwezinkomba — okuhlanganisa abalingiswa, izindawo, kanye nezinto ezisetshenziswayo ezihambisana nesitayela sobuciko somkhiqizo wakho.

Dala izithombe zokuqala (pre-vis) zesigaba ngasinye esinezinkulumo, imiphumela yomsindo (SFX), nomculo — futhi ulungise indlela yokukhiqiza ngaphakathi kwegumbi lokubuka (screening room) ngendlela engabizi.
Vumela uhlaka oluyisibonelo (Pre-Vis), bese ukhiqiza ividiyo enyakazayo yesigcawu ngasinye enokufakwa kwamazwi ngezilimi eziningi kanye nokulungiswa okwenziwa ezingeni lesigcawu.
Thumela ifayela eliyinhloko le-Prores 4K elivela ku-Screening Room — likushicilele ngokuzenzakalelayo ku-YouTube noma ulande iphakethe.

pricing.title: Qala nge-Explorer — $9
pricing.subtitle: Qala ifilimu yakho yokuqala namuhla ngo-$9—guqula umbono wakho wenze i-Blueprint ehlelekile, usakaze abalingisi bakho, futhi uhlole kuqala isigcawu sakho sokuqala. Bese ubhalisa ukuze ugcine i-Continuity Vault yakho futhi wengeze amakhredithi njengoba uqeda ukukhiqiza kwakho.
pricing.explorerHighlight: Awekho amakhono obuchwepheshe okwenza ifilimu adingekayo—akhelwe ababalisi bezindaba bansuku zonke, abadali be-indie isahluko ngesahluko, iziteshi zochungechunge, nezitudiyo zamafilimu ayingxube.

filmmakerPerspectives.heading: Ipayipi elilodwa leStudio. Yakhelwe Wonke Umxoxi Wezindaba & Umenzi Wefilimu.
filmmakerPerspectives.subheading: Awudingi isikole samafilimu noma amakhono obuchwepheshe ukuze uveze umbono wakho. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi wenza indaba yomuntu siqu iphile okokuqala ngqa, ushicilela uchungechunge lwesahluko ngesahluko, uphakamisa abaxhasi bezimali, noma uqhuba ukudubula okuxubile, uhlelo lwakho lulinganisa indlela odala ngayo.

cards.title: Abaxoxi bezindaba & Ababonisi Abaqanjiwe
cards.description: Unendaba, umqondo wencwadi, noma umlando womndeni ofuna ukuwubona esikrinini? Chaza umbono wakho ngamagama alula ukuze udale izithombe ze-Pre-Vis ezinezwi neziqeshana zevidiyo ezikhethiwe—ngenkathi ugcina abalingiswa bakho, amawodrophu, namasethi kugcinwe ku-Continuity Vault yakho.

cards.title: Isu Lokushicilela Isahluko
cards.description: Yeqa izindleko nesithiyo sesikhathi sokunikeza isici esiyimizuzu engama-90 ngaphambili. Shicilela indaba yakho ezigcawini zemizuzu engu-5–15 noma izahluko zesiqephu ukuze uphathe ibhajethi yakho yokubala yenyanga kuyilapho ukhulisa izithameli zakho kancane kancane.

cards.title: Umlingiswa kanye Nokusetha Ukuqhubeka kochungechunge
cards.description: Izithameli zibhalisela iziteshi uma zixhumana nabalingiswa abajwayelekile kanye nomhlaba. I-Continuity Vault yakho ilondoloza ubuso babalingisi, izingubo, ama-clone wezwi ngokwezifiso, nezindawo kuzo zonke iziqephu ukuze ukhule ngokuqhubekayo ku-YouTube, i-TikTok, ne-Reels.

cards.title: Amaphakheji Okuxhaswa Kwezimali Zokukhiqiza & Ukudutshulwa Okuxubile
cards.description: Khipha izikripthi ezisezingeni lomkhakha (PDF, FDX, Fountain) ezibhangqwe ne-Pre-Vis Animatic kanye ne-Trailer ye-Promo ukuze uvikele uxhaso lwabatshalizimali—noma ulayishe izigcawu eziqoshwe bukhoma futhi uzihlanganise nezithombe ze-4K AI ngengxenyana yezindleko zokukhiqiza ezibonakalayo.

membershipModel.title: Qala Iphrojekthi Yakho Namuhla. Linganisa Ngezengezo Njengoba Ukhiqiza.
membershipModel.description: I-SceneFlow ihlukanisa ukusingathwa kwe-studio esiqhubekayo nokubamba i-Continuity Vault kusukela kukhompyutha yokukhiqiza eqhumayo—ukuze abalingiswa bakho nomhlaba wonke kuhlale kukhiyiwe unyaka wonke, futhi ungakwazi ukugcwalisa amakhredithi noma nini lapho ulungele ukuqeda isahluko noma isici.

pillars.title: 1. Ubulungu Basesisekelo Bugcina I-Vault Yakho Eqhubekayo
pillars.description: Uhlelo olusebenzayo lwanyanga zonke ($19–$599/mo) lugcina ukufinyelela kwesitudiyo sakho, izixhumanisi ze-Screening Room, kanye ne-Active Continuity Vault—ilondoloza ubuso bakho abalingisi abaphindelelayo, amawodrophu, ama-clone ezwi angokwezifiso, izindawo, nama-Series Bibles kuzo zonke izinkathi zonyaka, kanye namakhredithi ayisisekelo anyanga zonke.

pillars.title: 2. Qeda Noma Iyiphi Iphrojekthi Efunwa Ngayo Ngamaphekhi Okwengeza Wezinyanga Eziyi-12
pillars.description: Uma indaba yakho inyakaza, amalungu asebenzayo anyanga zonke angathenga u-$25, $100, noma amaphakethe esikweletu e-Add-On angu-$250 noma nini ukuze aqedele isahluko, isizini yeziqephu eziningi, noma ukushutha kwesici esiyingxubevange. Amaphekhi ezengezo ezinyangeni ezingu-12 ezedlule kuyilapho ubulungu bakho busasebenza.

teamCta.title: Ithimba langaphakathi noma isikhungo?
teamCta.description: Bhukha iseshini yokubuka inqubo yokusebenza yamaqembu ezokuxhumana, ezokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi (L&D), kanye nawokumaketha.
